name: bantay-kalikasan-menro
description: Bantay Kalikasan - MENRO Portal for Municipality of Rizal

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c green,blue "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.dev:host: concurrently -n api,web -c green,blue "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web -- --host"
scripts.dev:desktop: concurrently -k "npm run dev" "wait-on http://localhost:5173 && npm run start -w @bantay-kalikasan/desktop"
